author: mgallagher56
body:
E12 S2c (plan 9.5): mobile e2e harness. S2a waits for OS1; S2b for S2a.

- `apps/mobile/e2e/fixture-server`: WorkOS stand-in and canned `/v1`, loopback only
- CI `🤖 Mobile e2e (Android)`: Maestro flows on an emulator, light and dark, screenshots kept 7 days. Not required yet
- No data leaves CI: no secrets, no Maestro Cloud, no analytics
- Proves Hermes on Android only; iOS unverified

**Tests**: 41 fixture and installer tests, CI job config tests, Biome and bundle cases; each seen failing (10 mutations caught). None weakened.

**Guard changes** (coordinator sign-off, 25 Nov): new job, not required; bundle markers; Biome import ban; knip entry.

**Dependencies**: setup-java v6.3.0 (14 Nov), android-emulator-runner v2.38.0 (5 Jul), Maestro 2.12.1 (2 Nov), babel-jest 30.5.2 (18 Sep)

**Seam cost**: 0

**Reviewed by**: fresh opus reviewer and `security-reviewer` (opus). Findings fixed. Not verified: real WorkOS, iOS.
